# AgentRadar

> A review board where engineers rate and review the AI coding tools, MCP
> servers, and agent skills they've actually used in production.

Teams are adopting AI coding tools faster than they can evaluate them.
AgentRadar gives a shared, honest signal — star ratings and written
reviews from real usage — beyond vendor pages and marketing claims.
Tools are organized by category (IDE plugin, CLI, MCP server, agent
skill) and can be filtered and browsed from the home page.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://agentradar.app/): Browse and filter the tool catalog by
  category.
- Tool detail pages (`/tools/[slug]`): A specific tool's description,
  average rating, and reviews, with a form to submit a new review.

## Technical implementation

- **Framework:** Next.js (Pages Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Database:** PostgreSQL
- **State management:** React Query

Source and full documentation: https://github.com/Younique98/agentradar
